subject: Onboarding request — temporary invoice-only option and evidence checklist for Aurora Consulting
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@auroraconsult.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@auroraconsult.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: initial ask re PO requirement for pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're excited to kick off the 8-week pilot with Redwood (Aurora Consulting / Analytics team). Procurement asked me to confirm the billing path before we start: our standard process is to issue POs, but for short pilots our central finance team is stretched and issuing a PO will add a 2–3 week delay.

Scope: 8-week pilot, up to $8,500 total usage; annual contract after pilot if results look good.

Question: Is there an option for a temporary invoice-only path (vendor onboarding with an exceptions approval) so we can pay invoices net30 without a PO for the pilot? If so, what evidence do you need from our side (W9, insurance certs, scope/SOW, contact for billing)?

If a PO is absolutely required, can you confirm the minimum lead time so we can plan.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Best,
Maya Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Consulting
attachments: none
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@auroraconsult.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial ask re PO requirement for pilot

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear summary. We're excited to run the pilot with Aurora. Short answers up front: yes, we can evaluate a temporary invoice-only path for pilots under a one-time exception; there are a few conditions and a short evidence checklist we need to collect.

What we'll need from Aurora to start the exception review (starter checklist below):
- Fully completed vendor intake form (CSV or portal upload)
- W9 (or equivalent tax form) and company EIN
- Certificate of insurance (GL limit >= $1M typical; let us know if lower)
- Point of contact for billing (name/email/phone) and remit address
- Short SOW or summary of deliverables and expected spend (line items helpful)
- Any required compliance attestations (if data will include customer PII)

I've attached our onboarding_evidence_checklist.pdf and a vendor_intake_form.csv template to this message to make it easier.

Internal next steps: looping in Marissa (procurement) and Karthik (legal) to confirm approval ladder and any additional conditions. Marissa — any immediate thresholds you want to flag? Karthik — I'll need legal's redline tolerance for pilot SOWs (standard 30d invoicing ok?).

If it helps, we can provisionally approve a limited invoice-only lane while the paperwork is collected, but final billing/contract activation will require completed forms and the temporary exception signed off. Happy to set a 20-min call today or tomorrow to speed this up.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: onboarding_evidence_checklist.pdf, vendor_intake_form.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@auroraconsult.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial ask re PO requirement for pilot

Hi Maya — appreciate the detail. Procurement is fine to consider a temporary waiver for pilots but we follow an approval ladder and evidence gating. To be explicit about what we can approve today vs what we require before invoices are processed: 

Proposed temporary exception (what Redwood can provisionally offer):
- Invoice-only onboarding allowed for pilot up to $25,000 total spend cap (pilot spend you quoted is within this)
- Term: 3 months max, with a quarterly review to convert to standard PO route if continuing beyond pilot
- Payment terms: Net30 from invoice date
- Required evidence (must be submitted within 7 business days): W9, vendor intake form, certificate of insurance, billing contact, short SOW (1–2 pages)
- Procurement will issue a one-time exception record: PROC-2027-045 — please include this on invoices.

Conditions we need if any data ingestion is involved: proof that Aurora will not share customer PII without an executed DPA; if PII is in scope, Legal needs to review and sign the DPA before production access.

Next steps for Aurora: complete the attached procurement_temp_exception_form.pdf and return the evidence bundle. Once we receive everything, we'll finalize the exception within 2 business days and confirm the invoice route. If anything is missing beyond 7 business days, invoices may be held until evidence is complete.

Naomi, happy to take a 15-min call with Maya to walk through the checklist if helpful. Maya — proposed times: Thu 4/8 2:00pm PT or Fri 4/9 10:00am PT.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: procurement_temp_exception_form.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@auroraconsult.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial ask re PO requirement for pilot

Thanks all. From Legal's perspective a temporary invoice-only exception is acceptable with two caveats: 
1) We need a signed SOW or short services letter that limits Redwood's exposure for the pilot (deliverables, timeframe, capped liability aligned to $25k cap).
2) Standard payment terms of Net30 are fine; however, if Aurora requests any custom payment language (early pay discounts, P-card only, etc.) that will need Legal review and may delay approval.

If PII is in scope, we require the DPA signed before any customer data is processed (Marissa noted this). For speed, we can accept a redlined SOW back to legal with a 48-hour turnaround window for small pilots.

If Aurora can return the checklist + SOW + W9 + COI this week, Procurement will finalize PROC-2027-045 and Finance will accept invoices against that reference.

Maya — can you confirm the billing contact and whether PII will be included in the pilot? If yes, please route the DPA to legal@auroraconsult.com and cc me.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
